play_equipment.evidence: A dark round object at the top edge of the outline, near the northern fence line, could be a trampoline, but it sits mostly at or beyond the boundary and is partly shaded, so it is not clearly inside the lot.

signals.notes: Pool is on the neighboring lot to the east, outside the outline; the central house is heavily shaded by mature trees to the south and east, with a deck on the rear and a paved driveway strip on the west side that is empty.
